annotations.text:
The whole configuration collapses to one line.
Model · hardware · runtime · context read as a sentence you can scan in a second, and open only when you want to change something.

The verdict is the page, not a section of it.
Headline numbers sit directly under it; the memory breakdown, findings, attention backend, command and comparison are demoted below or folded away.

Findings are triaged, not listed.
Blockers and warnings show in full; informational notes collapse to a single counted row.

PROPOSED — not in the app today.
"What would make it fit" turns a dead end into next steps. The three options here are real results from your own cluster; say the word and I'll cut it or build it.
